attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Delaware military retirement exemption (2025). Flat $12,500 exemption (no age requirement). Honors MSRRA and SCRA. Source: MOAA State Report Card, DE Division of Revenue.

Calculates Delaware state income tax per Form 200-01. Delaware uses progressive tax brackets with 7 rates: 0% on first $2,000, 2.2% on $2,000-$5,000, 3.9% on $5,000-$10,000, 4.8% on $10,000-$20,000, 5.2% on $20,000-$25,000, 5.55% on $25,000-$60,000, 6.6% above $60,000. Starting with federal AGI, applies standard deduction based on filing status ($3,250 Single, $6,500 MFJ), then calculates tax using progressive brackets.
